en.t: Whirling snow covered the sky and did not stop all day.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言怅望沉思，直到黄昏，世人所厌恶的、十二月的月亮，高照在明净如水的碧空中。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, gazed wistfully and sank into thought until dusk, while the moon of the twelfth month, which people so dislike, shone high in the clear, water-bright blue sky.

units.source_text: 他就卷起帘子，举头望月，又“欹枕”而听那边山寺中宣告“今日又空过”的隐约的晚钟声。

en.t: He rolled up the blinds, raised his head to look at the moon, and, leaning on his pillow, listened to the faint evening bell from the mountain temple over there, as it seemed to announce that today too had passed in vain.
